text:
Priya: Quick check on the routing editor mock I pushed. Main asks: compact stack behavior on narrow screens, preview log phrasing for conflicts, and keyboard focus for reorder controls. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/routing-editor-proto
Jon: Compact stack idea: collapse to single-line summary with count and top rule snippet. Tapping expands full rules. On mobile show a chevron + aria-expanded.
Sumi: Copy nudge: inline badge should be short — 'Overridden' — and preview detail can say 'Overridden by Rule 12 (higher priority)'. Avoid 'mutation' word.
Noah: Keyboard/accessibility: when moving a rule, keep focus on the moved item. Provide buttons for move up/down (aria-labels) in addition to drag. Announce reorder success via aria-live.
design-bot: Accessibility scan: conflict badge contrast 2.7:1  fail. Suggest darker token or add icon and aria-label. Chevron hit target 20x20px  increase to 24x24.
Priya: UX decision: short badges in-list, verbose explanation in preview panel. Also optimistic reorder with undo toast (Evan can wire).
Jon: Small animation for expand/collapse OK but respect prefers-reduced-motion. Keep duration ~80-120ms.
Sumi: Change modal CTA from 'Resolve' to 'Choose action' and default to 'Edit rule' to avoid accidental drops.
Noah: For preview logs, show matched rule highlighted and include a small timeline scrubber. Lazy-load diffs when user expands a frame to save compute.
Priya: Agreed. Action items: Sumi update copy strings; Jon mock compact stack + motion; Noah keyboard spec + aria-live; infra to add undo toast + optimistic reorder. Sync Thursday 10:00. Thanks!
